title: Kitchen experience — completion backlog

existing_kitchen_livewire: Boxes (receive Middo boxes, send empty to ops)
product_rules_agreed: Admin configures accept window, group size, kitchen tiers + default accept qty per tier
On kitchen activation, allowed_quantity is auto-copied from that kitchen's tier default; admin can override per kitchen
Kitchen can decline or report shortage; Middo reassigns
Kitchen can release accepted group back to pool before pack
Ready (kitchen done) is separate from rider pickup / dispatch
Kitchen can mark Middo box damaged before return to ops
Kitchen ledger: receivable from Middo + withdrawal + send-money-to-Middo with proof

items.title: Admin Settings: grouping & accept window
details: UI under Admin → Settings (or Ops config) for: accept_window_minutes, auto_meal_group_quantity (default 10)
Persist in settings / config table (not only .env)
MealOrderGrouper and Kitchen MealOrders read these values

items.title: Kitchen tiers + default accept quantity by tier
details: Define kitchen tiers: silver, gold, platinum (extensible enum/config)
Admin Settings: default_allowed_open_groups (or accept quantity) PER TIER — e.g. silver=1, gold=2, platinum=3 (example only; admin-editable)
Kitchens table: tier column (silver|gold|platinum) + allowed_open_groups (nullable until activated / set)
Admin can change a kitchen's tier anytime; optionally offer 'reset allowed qty to tier default' action
Admin can always override allowed_open_groups for a specific kitchen without changing the tier default

items.title: On activation: auto-apply tier default quantity
details: When admin activates a kitchen (KitchenOnboarding::activate or equivalent), if allowed_open_groups is empty/null, copy from Settings default for that kitchen's tier
If kitchen has no tier set at activation, require selecting a tier first (or default to silver)
After activation, admin can still edit that kitchen's allowed_open_groups independently
Changing tier defaults in Settings does NOT retroactively overwrite existing kitchens' allowed_open_groups (only new activations / explicit reset)

items.title: Enforce capacity / open-group slots
details: At accept time: kitchen may only hold up to allowed_open_groups concurrent open groups (definition: accepted/preparing/ready — not yet dispatched or released)
Hide or disable Accept when at capacity; show remaining slots
Tests for tier default copy on activate + per-kitchen override + capacity gate

phases.name: Accept / decline / release / ready vs pickup

items.title: Accept window + capacity guards on Accept
details: Reject accept if outside accept_window_minutes from schedule/group time
Reject accept if kitchen already at allowed_open_groups
Clear UX: countdown / slots remaining

items.title: Decline or report shortage → Middo reassign
details: Kitchen: Decline with reason OR Report shortage (items/qty)
Unassign kitchen; group returns to open pool or ops queue
Notify Middo ops; audit log

items.title: Kitchen release before pack
details: If accepted but not packed, kitchen can Release back to open pool
Clears one capacity slot; audit log

items.title: Split Ready vs Rider pickup / Dispatch
details: New kitchen action: Mark ready (prep complete, waiting for rider)
Dispatch / hand to rider remains separate (existing or renamed)
Statuses/UI: Open → Accepted → Preparing → Ready → Dispatched
Dashboard counts Ready separately from in-prep

items.title: Mark Middo box damaged (before send to ops)
details: While box is with kitchen (empty/full as allowed by rules), Mark damaged + note/photo optional
Status/path so ops sees damaged boxes; do not treat as normal empty return
Audit + notify ops

items.title: Box list UX polish
details: Clear filters: with me / sendable / damaged / history
Confirmations on receive / damage / send to Middo

phases.name: Kitchen money — receivable, withdraw, send to Middo

items.title: Kitchen account: Middo receivable balance
details: Show amount Middo owes kitchen (from settlement share rules)
Ledger / statement of earnings vs payouts

items.title: Kitchen withdrawal request
details: Kitchen requests withdrawal of receivable
Admin/ops approve/pay; reduce receivable

items.title: Send money to Middo (with proof)
details: Kitchen declares transfer to Middo + proof upload (bkash/bank ref)
Ops/admin confirm; reconcile against COD / dues

items.title: Cash handover scoped to this kitchen
details: Handover UI only shows riders/deliveries tied to this kitchen
Align with Middo cash ledger confirmation

items.title: Accepted-groups ingredient rollup
details: From recipes on menus in accepted/preparing groups, aggregate ingredients × qty
Printable / exportable prep sheet for the day

items.title: Kitchen alerts
details: New open group in catchment
Accept window ending
Rider assigned / arrived for Ready orders
Box / money confirmation updates

items.title: SLA warn before accept window ends
details: Dashboard badge / list highlight for groups nearing deadline

items.title: Permission matrix cleanup for kitchen role
